extraction.Name: Annie Larvie
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded. The receipt for patent was sign April 3, 1920, by the allottee.
extraction.Buyer: Northeast quarter mortgaged March 28, 1923 to Henry J. Abrahams for $800, due April 1, 1928. Southeast quarter mortgaged August 11, 1923, for $517.36 to the Memorial Art Company, and on January 5, 1925, this mortgage was foreclosed.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Tax certificate 4514 for 1921 was recorded for the Northeast quarter, and certificate No. 4515 for the Southeast quarter.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739663 issued; East half of section 34, T. 45, north of range 32. Southeast quarter mortgaged June 4, 1923 per document date reference.
